<description>
**Problem:** Test helpers that attach active-tip templates to arbitrary parents retain the template's subsidy.
Existing reorg tests can pass with underpaid coinbases.
A fork crossing a halving can overpay and fail with `bad-cb-amount`.
At heights 1 through 16, encoding only the height leaves the coinbase input script too short and triggers `bad-cb-length`.

**Fix:** Share parent-dependent reconstruction between `BuildChain()` and `MinerTestingSetup::Block()`, deriving difficulty and coinbase fields from the actual parent.
Pad rebuilt coinbase input scripts.
Require coinbase-only templates so replacing the reward with the subsidy cannot discard transaction fees.
</description>
